items.title: A Midsummer Night's Dream
items.excerpt:
A sonnet for those who love the game to stay after sun is down. Let the dreamy colors inspire your journey to be imaginative and a bit chaotic!

This set of 10 grips contains five The Blossom: Moonshade and five Cloud & Wave: Afterglow.

items.title: The Blossom
items.excerpt: An ode to the elegance and soulful beauty of The Blossom of floral trees. Delicate petals and refreshing colors. Keep them around you on the course throughout the year with The Blossom grips.

items.title: Blossom, Boughs, Beneath
items.excerpt:
Celebrate the most anticipated season in golf with some poetic flares. Mix and match your clubs with shades of spring flowers.

This set of 10 grips contains five The Blossom and five The Blossom: Beneath the Boughs.

items.title: The Blossom: Beneath the Boughs
items.excerpt:
Let the paths take us through the nature to discover the most unforgettable memories. Find beauty even when you ended up beneath the boughs.

曲径通幽处，禅房花木深。

items.title: Cloud & Wave: Afterglow
items.excerpt:
The sun is already gone, though its memory still lingers in the sky and water.

Capture the moment while you chase a few more holes before it’s dark. Cloud & Wave: Afterglow preserves that part of the round you wish would last a little longer.

items.title: Pacific Summer
items.excerpt:
Clouds linger. The sky clears. Smoke drifts.

Pacific Summer is inspired by the ever-changing conditions of the California coast, where marine layers, clearing skies, and distant haze shape the rounds we remember most.

items.title: Waiting for You
items.excerpt:
Porcelain waited for the sky After the Rain… I’m still waiting for you.

This set of 10 grips contains five(5) The Blossom: Porcelain and five(5) The Blossom: After the Rain.

items.title: The Blossom: After the Rain
items.excerpt:
The rain has stopped, the sky cleared, and the world feels new again.

And still, the blossom remains. 

A reminder that beauty often arrives after the grey has gone.

items.title: The Blossom: Porcelain
items.excerpt: The Blossom grips meet stunning porcelain art. Embrace the elegance of these fine things!

items.title: The Zen Grip: Smoke
items.excerpt:
Smoke drifts through the air, shifting with every current yet never losing its form for long.

Momentum shifts, conditions change, and every moment asks for something different. The challenge is not to resist the change, but to move with it.

A reminder to stay composed through every turn of the journey.

items.title: Cloud & Wave: June Gloom
items.excerpt:
Low clouds drift across the shoreline, muting the colors of the day. The ocean disappears into the horizon, and time seems to slow with the tide.

The unmistakable mood of summer pacific golf.

items.title: 7-Grip Set
items.excerpt: Perfect set to put on the irons or whatever 7 clubs you love!

items.title: 3-Grip Set
items.excerpt: Three grips, one intention. The set is built for those who want their short game, their scoring clubs, or their most-trusted woods to carry the same story.

items.title: The Blossom: Moonshade
items.excerpt: The Blossom: Moonshade pays homage to golfers who polish their crafts at the range into the nightfall, until the last shot of the night when the stars come out.

items.title: Cloud & Wave: Twilight
items.excerpt: Twilight golf at the pacific coast-always unforgettable and always breathtaking. This version of Cloud & Wave is for those who want to remember the sunsets they chased.

items.title: The Blossom: First Light
items.excerpt: Inspired by golfers who camp for the first tee time. Reminisce the unique vibe of teeing off with the first light breaking the horizon.

items.title: The Blossom: Apricot
items.excerpt: Misty freshness and apricot blossom, brings you back to those dreamy spring mornings only exist in ancient poems.

items.title: Mountain & Mist
items.excerpt: Capturing the core memory of spring golf with misty weathers and verdant mountain backdrops.

items.title: The Zen Grip: Sand
items.excerpt: Warm shores, sunny riverbanks, new look of The Zen Grip in sandy bunker color… This spring, have yourself a good time even when you find the sand.

items.title: Blossom: Classic Collection
items.excerpt: Celebrate the Eastern traditional arts with three classic designs of The Blossom grips.

items.title: The Spring Haiku
items.excerpt: Spring is here. Embrace the poetic season with the newest colors in our collection!

items.title: Serenade Trio
items.excerpt: Elevate your game with elegance and precision. Immerse yourself in the Serenade of colors.

items.title: The Blossom: Palace Wall
items.excerpt: Blooming branches next to red walls, relive the most traditional memory of early spring with the Blossom grips in Palace Wall colorway.

items.title: The Blossom: Canvas
items.excerpt: The Blossom grips in a vintage look, reminiscing classic paintings of the blossom.

items.title: Cloud & Wave
items.excerpt: Best part about Pacific coastal golf is looking out to see the sky meets the ocean, where clouds meet the waves. Lock in the memory with our Cloud and Wave grips in your bag.

items.title: The Zen Grip
items.excerpt:
The bunker is where most golfers lose their composure. The Zen Grip is a reminder not to. Finds order in repetition and calm in precision, even in the sand.

Hit the shot. Rake the sand. Embrace the elements. Move on.
